previous_description: Defines a single boolean predicate evaluated against a request context attribute (field), comparing the runtime value using a specified operator. Composed inside a PolicyRule condition chain to form compound access control expressions.
definition: A single comparison predicate that tests one named request-context attribute (subject claim, resource property, environment value) against a literal or referenced value using one operator, and yields a denial message when false. It carries no effect of its own; it is evaluated as one term within a PolicyRule, ResourceOperation or InformationRight authorization check.

distinguish_from.when: the logic is a reusable, free-form or compound expression (time windows, combined attribute logic) rather than one field-operator-value test
the unit carries a permit/deny effect or obligations, not just a boolean test
the check enforces format, range or integrity of field data rather than deciding whether a principal may access something
the element grants named operations on an information entity to a specific actor, even if it embeds a constraint

standard_reference: NIST SP 800-53 AC-3 (Access Enforcement); XACML 3.0 Match element / NIST SP 800-162 ABAC attribute predicate
code_evidence: A guard clause in a handler or middleware that compares one request attribute to a value and throws or returns 403 with a message, e.g. if (req.user.tenantId !== resource.tenantId) throw new ForbiddenError('Tenant mismatch')
A declarative policy or config entry holding a field/operator/value triple, e.g. { attribute: 'token.scope', op: 'contains', value: 'orders:write' } in a Casbin, OPA input or custom rules file
A route or method annotation that asserts a single claim or attribute, e.g. @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('SCOPE_read')") or requireClaim('email_verified', true)

attribute_descriptions.name: field
attribute_descriptions.description: Dot-path name of the request-context attribute being tested (e.g. 'subject.role', 'resource.ownerId', 'env.ipAddress'), as it is resolved at evaluation time.

attribute_descriptions.name: value
attribute_descriptions.description: Comparison operand as a string: a literal, a comma-separated list for 'in', a regex for 'matches', or a context reference such as '${subject.id}'. Leave empty only for operator 'exists'.

attribute_descriptions.name: message
attribute_descriptions.description: Human-readable denial reason returned or logged when the predicate evaluates to false, e.g. 'Caller must belong to the resource tenant'.

attribute_descriptions.name: source
attribute_descriptions.description: Where the field value is read from in the request context, such as 'token', 'header', 'path', 'query', 'body', 'session' or 'environment'. Set it so evaluators know which input to resolve.

notes: 'source' is a required string here but an optional source-code-reference object on siblings; rename (e.g. attributeSource). Operator enum lacks gte/lte/not-in; value is string-only. Both 'accesscondition composes policyrule' and 'policyrule uses accesscondition' exist; the composition direction appears reversed. 'message' should not be required for every predicate.
